Bug_Title: VA: Primitive array passed to function expecting a variable number of object arguments (VA_PRIMITIVE_ARRAY_PASSED_TO_OBJECT_VARARG)
Bug_Details:
This code passes a primitive array to a function that takes a variable number of object arguments.
This creates an array of length one to hold the primitive array and passes it to the function.
Bug_Explanation: The method `concatenate` expects a variable number of object arguments (varargs of Object type). Instead, a primitive array `int[]` is passed to it. This leads to the primitive array being treated as a single object, rather than being expanded into individual elements as intended.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBugWithPrimitiveArray test case triggers the bug by passing a primitive int array to the showBug method, which leads to improper handling by the concatenate method. This test expects the array to be expanded into individual elements, but due to the bug, it treats the whole array as a single object.
